page.overview:
Who is Runa Blask?

Runa Blask was a female Togruta individual who was a Confederacy of Independent Systems partisan during the Clone Wars before she was forced out because of internal politics. She then acted as an advisor to the covert military group Zero Company, who was composed of both former Galactic Republic and Separatist members, at their headquarters known as the Den on the Ring of Kafrene. Blask remained a stern believer of the Separatist cause and saw her time with them as the best in her life and her later time with Zero Company as worthless. She was also a vocal critic of the Republic, which she saw as expansionist and imperialist, often bringing her into conflict with Zero Company's leader, Tesh Keff Hawks.

Blask was a financial professional who worked as Zero Company's personnel manager.

Runa Blask made her debut in the video game Star Wars Zero Company She is voiced by the comedian Vic Michaelis. They were first revealed and pictured by PC Gamer on March 26 of that year, but the picture was only fully confirmed to be then by Electronic Arts on social media on April 3.
